rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved, provided or sponsored by the ADA, AGD or ADHA; board-approved courses from dental schools or dental organizations; board-approved study clubs and self-study from a dental school, AGD or ADA
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: half the required contact hours for each complete year licensed in the concluding period, plus current CPR certification.
rules.audit_note: Signed statement of compliance on the renewal form; keep detailed CE records and produce them on request (12 AAC 02.960 audit).

topics.who: Holders of a federal DEA registration (pain management and opioid use and addiction)
Current hands-on CPR certification (AHA/Red Cross equivalent); max 4 CPR hours count; also at first renewal

rules.notes: Current CPR certification (AHA/Red Cross equivalent, hands-on) required; max 4 CPR hours count. Practice/risk management max 3 h; volunteer service max 2 h; internet CE max 8 h per 24-hour period. Sedation/GA permit holders need extra airway/sedation CE (12 AAC 28.010, .015).
